prompts.identity: Use case: stylized-concept. Production painted 2.5D RPG character sprite atlas, real transparent RGBA background. Reference images 1 and 2 establish the existing Vietnamese game world's brushwork, orthographic mildly overhead camera, detailed materials and compact 3.5–4-head chibi proportions; do not copy those slender characters. Create one NEW Vietnamese male FIRE WARRIOR, visibly strong and powerful: very broad muscular shoulders, thick exposed upper arms, a large chest narrowing at the waist, sturdy legs, masculine youthful angular face and assertive brows. Compact short swept-up black hair, tied crimson warrior headband, no long fluffy mage ponytail. Asymmetrical dark iron and antique bronze shoulder armour, sleeveless dark crimson Vietnamese fantasy warrior tunic with gold ember motif, red waist sash, dark fitted trousers and thick leather armguards/boots. Weapon: one massive single-edged curved dao / great sabre, broad charcoal steel blade, bronze guard with restrained ember orange engraved edge. Clearly recognizable Fire warrior without surrounding VFX. Precisely EIGHT separate FULL-BODY figures of this SAME character, exact costume/weapon/proportions in FOUR columns by TWO rows. Row 1: idle FRONT/down toward viewer, idle RIGHT side, idle BACK/up away, idle LEFT side. Row 2: RIGHT-facing ready stance holding the great sabre low forward; RIGHT-facing beginning overhead heavy cleave; RIGHT-facing finishing a grounded horizontal cleave; RIGHT-facing defensive guard with blade raised diagonally across torso. Same head and body size across all cells, consistent row foot baseline. All feet, sword tips and armour fully inside their own cells, generous margins and real transparent gutters. Heavy grounded posture, body noticeably wider and more muscular than the Archer and Mage references. Hand-painted soft textured shading and fine metal highlights, not thick black anime outlines, readable at 80px tall. NO text, labels, grid lines, smoke, fire particles, ground shadow, background glow, scenery, checkerboard or opaque backdrop. No water staff, bow or feminine slender figure. Actual alpha transparency outside every figure.
prompts.finalCore: Use case: precise-object-edit. The reference image is the exact character design to PRESERVE: face, hair, muscles, costume, colours, weapon and all eight pose identities. Re-layout this same eight-pose sprite atlas into a PORTRAIT canvas with exactly TWO columns and FOUR rows, NOT four columns/two rows. Each cell is wide enough for its complete weapon; generous fully transparent gutters at least 40px between all silhouettes. Row 1: idle front and idle right. Row 2: idle back and idle left. Row 3: ready right and overhead attack preparation right. Row 4: finished attack right and defensive guard right. The adjacent weapon tips currently touch other characters: separate every figure completely and finish every weapon tip without any neighbouring body behind it. Preserve one consistent head/body scale and original strong muscular silhouette across all eight poses. Full feet and weapon must remain inside each cell with empty margins. No background, ground shadow, labels, text, gridlines or VFX. REAL alpha transparency outside every figure. Prefer portrait 1024 by 1536 or 1536 by 2048; wide cells and visibly clear spacing matter more than filling the canvas.
prompts.run: Use case: stylized-concept. Production painted 2.5D Vietnamese RPG RUNNING SPRITE ATLAS, real transparent RGBA. Input image is the EXACT character design, weapon, face, muscular body and costume to preserve. Exactly SIXTEEN isolated full-body running figures in FOUR columns by FOUR rows on a square canvas, preferably 2048x2048. Row 1: RUNNING RIGHT four successive phases; Row 2: RUNNING DOWN toward camera four phases; Row 3: RUNNING UP away from camera four phases with back visible; Row 4: RUNNING LEFT four phases. A real alternating stride: column 1 left leg forward/right leg back, column 2 passing feet, column 3 right leg forward/left leg back, column 4 airborne recovery. Same face/head and muscle/body scale throughout, consistently mild overhead orthographic camera. Each figure occupies only about 65–70 percent of its cell height; generous transparent space on ALL four sides, including below feet. Weapon held close to torso diagonally forward/down while running; complete weapon tip and all feet inside the SAME cell. Every silhouette must be disconnected from every neighbouring pose, at least 30px of fully transparent gutter. Keep the original masculine strong body and broad shoulders in ALL directions, not a slimmer mage body. Refined soft painterly shading and metal/fabric texture consistent with Archer/Mage. NO text, labels, grid lines, floor, shadow, environment, spell VFX, haze or opaque background. Actual alpha transparency outside each figure. Character-specific invariants: a massive curved single-edged dao with ember engraving; short black spiky hair and red headband; sleeveless crimson warrior tunic, dark iron/bronze armour, thick bare upper arms.

layout.core: 2 columns x 4 rows: idle down/right/up/left, ready/windup/strike/guard
layout.run: 4 columns x 4 rows: right/down/up/left, four phases each

runtime: 160 x 112 logical pixels, resolution 3, foot anchor (80,104). Fixed body scale; complete silhouette extraction.
scope: Character art + rehearsal preview; gameplay skills and balance not implemented.
